meta.name: Digital Native — illustrated forest studio
meta.description: Inferred from the supplied video, adapted to real Three.js architecture. Values are local implementation choices, not verified source-code tokens.

neutral.usage: parchment reading surfaces, dark ink, fine dividers

color.contrast_strategy: cream on deep teal in the hero; dark ink on opaque parchment when reading

font_families.heading: Cormorant Garamond; Noto Sans KR for Korean

typography.font_style_notes: Reference has narrow, high-contrast serif display. Exact family is unknown; local Cormorant is an interpretation. Korean uses a consistent sans family.

layout.grid_system: asymmetric scene left, editorial copy right

elevation.shadow_style: minimal UI shadows; cel-shaded geometric depth
elevation.depth_cues: perspective, foliage layers, warm foreground/cool background

iconography.style: fine geometric monogram and plain arrows

motion.easing: quintic smoothstep; exponential damping for optional scroll tour; active travel at display refresh rate, idle scenery at 20 fps
motion.entrance_pattern: fully composed garden on first frame; room copy enters during final camera deceleration with a crisp 10px rise and 40ms line stagger; scroll tour scrubs the same stagger
motion.exit_pattern: summary fades in place over 200ms; outgoing details close while room travel begins immediately
motion.philosophy: cinematic on request; optional saved scroll tour, off by default; summary and detail UI share one fixed camera pose per room

components.button_style: small cream rectangular CTA and quiet text links
components.card_style: opaque parchment walls framed by architecture
components.navigation_pattern: transparent header and persistent room controls
components.list_style: editorial product ledger with fine dividers
components.component_notes: Existing bilingual content, links, prices and video controls are retained. Journal is Press.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: software as a living house of ideas

visual_language.ornamentation: arched windows, shutters, terracotta eaves, vines
visual_language.whitespace_usage: a clear right-hand reading area within a dense forest
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: warm tower left; cream typography right
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle procedural plaster grain and cel-shaded foliage

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast and warm/cool color separation
composition.flow_direction: tower to headline to room invitation
composition.grouping_strategy: real sections inhabit individual storeys and wings
composition.negative_space_role: quiet area for copy, without hiding the garden

imagery.illustration_style: original cel-shaded 3D interpretation of a painterly reference
imagery.graphic_elements: cream monogram, thin frames, editorial serif
imagery.pattern_usage: roof tiles, shutter slats, pigment grain

interaction_feel.feedback_style: active destination underline and immediate control state
interaction_feel.loading_style: local illustrated tower until the first rendered frame

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: truthful Press placeholder and contact route
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: quiet fallback with all content accessible

overview.fallback_strategy: local tower illustration plus native document content
overview.primary_technology: WebGL/Three.js architecture with viewport-anchored native HTML reading panels

background_effects.description: layered teal tree grove behind an ochre tower

3d_elements.description: four-storey planted tower and two garden wings

params.lighting: hemisphere fill and warm directional sun
params.camera: perspective, full garden composed on first frame
params.materials: toon plaster, wood, teal roof, parchment
params.geometry: boxes, extruded arches, cones, instanced foliage
params.interaction_model: room selection, bounded drag look, keyboard arrows, Home reset

parallax.depth_range: wide garden through all six architectural rooms
parallax.speed_curve: damped native scroll progress; optional toggle, disabled by default

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: one camera stop per room, shared by summary, UI-only reveal, and reading; camera moves only between rooms without depth excursions; bilingual summaries and full UI occupy a stable reading area beside the architecture
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: one content-sized document scroll at native 1:1 scale; no wheel cancellation, snapping, or nested scrolling; changing summary/details never changes camera pose; reverse scrolling restores both; reduced motion disables animation but retains summaries

canvas_drawings.description: static generated plaster and architectural signage textures

svg_animations.description: static original fallback tower and favicon

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference is a short animated illustration; its rendering technology cannot be determined from the video. The local adaptation intentionally uses original true 3D geometry so every section remains in the architecture. No external artwork is shipped. The garden needs no entrance interaction. Reduced motion disables camera animation; hidden/offscreen rendering pauses.
